messages.subject: [RQt-devel] Should qtpaint export qtbase::qrect?
messages.body_plain:
Problem is that qtpaint would then have to document qrect. qtpaint and
qtbase are two low-level packages that will generally be used by other
packages, so hopefully this does not place too much burden on the user.

Michael

the gsDesign R package and need someone with experience in above areas.  The
project will begin in the next couple of weeks and last about 2 months.
Please let me know if you'd have interest.
